castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, overlooking the valley.
castle.defense: Arrow slits, thick walls and walkways tell its defensive purpose.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble halls were the stage of medieval intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still preserve traces of ancient detentions.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel for the love of a lady.

monuments.title: Monuments of the Village
monuments.castle_desc: One of the largest medieval castles in Sicily, overlooking the San Leonardo valley. This Norman fortress from the 11th century preserves prisons, historic halls, and fascinating legends.
monuments.annunziata_title: Church of SS. Annunziata and San Benedetto della Badia
monuments.annunziata_desc: Two adjacent churches, symbols of local devotion. The Annunziata features refined Baroque stuccoes, while the Badia preserves crypts and a beautiful majolica floor.
monuments.sangiorgio_title: Church of Saint George the Martyr
monuments.sangiorgio_desc: One of the oldest churches in the village, with a Norman‑Gothic façade and precious wooden statues, standing with the castle rising behind it.
monuments.angeli_title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
monuments.angeli_desc: A small Franciscan church immersed in silence, featuring a marble altar and the remains of Blessed Giovanni, a deeply beloved spiritual figure.
monuments.cappuccini_desc: Founded in the 16th century, it houses a sober cloister and a historic library. It offers a panoramic view over the valley.

castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.leading_para: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley as a millenary strategic bulwark.
castle.para_2: Every corner of this manor exudes charm and mystery: from the famous Conspiracy Hall, the theater of intrigues and pacts between medieval nobles, to the ancient Inquisition prisons carved into the stone.
castle.para_3: Between history and legend, the spirit of Sister Felicia still protects the village. The Castellana awaits you in chat to reveal every secret of this timeless place.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or do you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Just ask me.

monuments.chat_hint: Click on my cards to explore them with me! ✨
monuments.welcomemsg_churches: The Castellana: Welcome to the heart of Caccamo's sacredness, stranger. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of these living walls? Just ask me.
